about.title: Company Introduction
about.text: Henan Kuncai Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. is the exclusively authorized partner of Zhendong Group for the products and international business presented on this website. Founded in 1993, Zhendong Group operates across pharmaceuticals, functional health foods, healthcare products, Chinese medicinal herb development, herbal supplements and functional beverages. The Group includes ten major industrial enterprises, 32 subsidiaries and four research platforms, with HACCP-certified food-safety operations and CNAS-accredited testing capabilities. Through this exclusive authorization, we provide overseas distributors, importers, wholesalers and health brands with OEM, ODM, private-label, customized-packaging and bulk-supply services.
